name: High Mountain Valley
title: High Mountain Valley
summary: A valley in the Linvak Mountains with an Empyrean ruin site: a bunker, an Empyrean platform and a meeting hall with a portal to Desert Ridge Border. The Lost Garden Ruins are nearby (acpedia). In the kit, a moss-green two-storey meeting hall, a small pitched-roof bunker and a 20 m fabric-covered Empyrean platform sit on the flat valley floor at z 168. Forested slopes rise 20-80 m to the north and east.

site.name: High Mountain Valley
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer high-mountain-valley (outdoor, on the valley floor 32 m north-west of the Empyrean platform). Landblocks north of y 9024 (0xC92F-0xCC2F) and east of x 39168 (0xCC2C-0xCC2E) are missing from the kit: every camera stays south-west of them.

shots.standingOrder: Pull back and up west from the Empyrean platform and its moss-green meeting hall, the afternoon sun behind you, until the ruins sit small on the floor of the high Linvak valley; 8 m above every tree.
shots.notes: Dronie from 30 m off the Empyrean platform and the moss-green meeting hall, pulling back west and up to 38 m. The ruins shrink on the floor of the high Linvak valley as the forested slopes rise behind them. The afternoon sun (0.60) is 46 degrees behind-right of the lens. The bearing is chosen to pass 13 m clear of the valley's 24 m pine.
